resolutions.title: Iteration-aware logic can mark unresolved external findings as converged
resolutions.decision: two-path convergence (Path A: markdown content parsed for clean; Path B: address-reviews JSON resolution check)
resolutions.action: Expanded the orbit-review spec delta's system-mode no-CRITICAL coverage from 3 states (no-external / converged / stale) to 5 states: (1) no prior external; (2) external content clean — Path A convergence; (3) external resolved via address-reviews — Path B convergence; (4) external present with unresolved findings; (5) external stale relative to artifact changes. Added a precedence-rules scenario for cases where multiple states could match (stale takes precedence over Path A/B/unresolved; unresolved takes precedence over Path A/B). orbit-review's implementation now inspects 3 new file types: external-system-*.md (markdown parse for clean detection), address-reviews-*.json (JSON resolution_summary check), apply-*.json (filename token comparison for stale). Scenario count: 10 → 14 in orbit-review delta. design.md D-logic-1 rewritten to document the 5-state state machine.
